name: [UPD 4] Chasing 🔪
desc:
You are just a subject. 

You’ve been captured and will be used by a criminal organization to create the worst serial killers that have ever existed. You’re on your own, whether you’re the one doing the killing or the one about to be killed.

🩹 SURVIVORS: Complete all objectives and survive until 6:00 to leave the round alive.
🔪 KILLER: Kill every survivor, show absolutely no mercy.

📱💻🎮 Supports PC, Mobile, Tablet, Console

[GAME IS IN ALPHA, EXPECT BUGS AND CHANGES]
